name: hbm_xp_buf_rptr_1014-rptr1-COMMIT
purpose: A2 HBM group A 10-14: BUF predecode failed GRT-0116 twice (172.8x108 decode1-4ed325b0c, 220.32x108 wide1-2ce3529c5, markers 2341->3154 over the E half). Cut arithmetic: the 8,192-b unit image shifted slice c <- c+1 (BF16) / c+2 (block-dot) every emit beat, so every inter-slice cut carried 1,024 + 2x1,024 = 3,072 b of shift data + ~532 b of flat writes ~= 3,600 b vs 3,728 horizontal tracks (0.97 > 0.60) at any width. Structural fix (RTL ot_hbm_xp_buf_rptr): the image is static after its write and a registered read pointer (16 kept beat/format copies, one per 128-b ob_d chunk) selects slice e (BF16) or slices 2e..2e+1 (block-dot) into ob_d: no per-beat shift traffic; the 8:1/4:1 select is static fan-in that placement keeps bit-local. Same pins, outline 220.32x108, same write decode; exact vs original ot_hgi_xp_buf 256 frames 8,569 cycle comparisons 1,536 beats PASS, lane mutant FAIL (local Verilator).
